title: Bulk Email Mail Settings Permission Consistency

migration.reason: All consumed permission codes already exist in Core.

backend.reason: Existing backend authorization and bulk-email sender requirements remain unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contract changes are introduced; the frontend list wrapper now fails closed before issuing an unauthorized email-account list request.

tenant_isolation.reason: No backend resource lookup, query, or organization-scoping behavior changes.

audit.reason: No mutation or audit behavior changes.

menu.reason: Operations navigation remains controlled by existing operation permissions.

route_guard.reason: The existing operations.create route guard is unchanged.

notes: Bulk Email creation still requires an explicit sender account because preview/send payloads require email_account_id. Mail-template read and email-account read remain separate permissions. The email-account list client now fails closed locally when email_accounts.read is absent, so workflows such as the Bulk Email wizard cannot issue an unauthorized /email-accounts request and surface a permission-specific 403 instead. Authorized callers keep the existing list behavior; backend permission and payload contracts are unchanged.
